WHAT_CHANGED_AT_CLAIM_358517.the_confirmed_blocker: fresh.prepare returned `planned` immediately after mint(apply=False) -- BEFORE anything parsed task.json, configure-inputs.json or submission.json, BEFORE any contract was composed, and BEFORE --distro or --repository-source were examined. The reviewer's independent reproduction therefore got planned:true from a malformed task plus a nonexistent bundle, and the apply then CREATED THE DESTINATION and persisted authority-identity.json before raising JSONDecodeError. A partial installation from an error knowable without writing anything is exactly what a preflight exists to prevent.
WHAT_CHANGED_AT_CLAIM_358517.the_fix: A real pre-mint gate, fresh.static_refusals, which parses all four documents, enforces the packet pins AND a pin on the imported helper AND the inherited pins, checks isolation of every ACTUALLY CONSUMED path, requires an executable bundle and a usable repository source, and REHEARSES the whole manifest/submission cross-binding against a deliberately provisional authority. Nothing is minted until all of it answers.
